dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Hello. Do you need any accessories or weapons today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You make both?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right. Is anything the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: To the people of the Children of Echoes, there's little difference between forging accessories and forging weapons. Both involve using phlogiston to process ore.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: It is also extremely common to adorn weapons and accessories with gems. Any piece of equipment that doesn't have a gemstone engraved on it is of no use at all.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: On the other hand, if you see someone digging for ore with a chisel that's engraved with row upon row of crystals, you can rest assured, for that's the surest sign that you've got a real expert on the job.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need either at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: No worries at all. Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Very impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: I feel the same way.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Still, I find that practice a bit too avant garde. The way I look at it, if you want to customize your tools, engraving two or three stones is more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Ah, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Cheven, the owner of Muhuru's Gemporium. I'm a jeweler by trade, but I know how to make weapons too.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Most of the weapons I make are in the traditional style. They've been proven to be reliable and easy to wield.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: If you'd like to check out some newer styles, you can try your luck with Xilonen. She's not always around, though — you might have to check every tree in Natlan to find her sunbathing spot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Very impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: I feel the same way.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Still, I find that practice a bit too avant-garde. The way I look at it, if you want to customize your tools, engraving two or three stones is more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Though I'm a jeweler myself, and opened Muhuru's Gemporium, I still do make some weapons...

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Though most of the weapons I make are in the traditional style. Their designs have stood the test of time, with a proven track record of being reliable and easy to wield.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: If you'd like to check out some newer styles, you can try your luck with Xilonen. She's not always around, though — you might have to check every tree in Natlan to find her sunbathing spot.
